mapper.select: SELECT pur.patient_id FROM patient_user_relation pur INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id=pur.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pur.user_id=#{userId} AND pur.relationship='SELF' AND pur.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pur.created_at ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient WHERE id=#{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient_user_relation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND patient_id=#{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)

SELECT p.id, p.patient_id, d.hospital_id, p.status FROM prescription p INNER JOIN consult_record cr ON cr.id=p.consult_id AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id=p.doctor_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.id=#{prescriptionId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT pi.drug_id, d.name AS drug_name, pi.quantity, pi.dosage, pi.frequency, pi.usage_method, pi.days FROM prescription_item pi INNER JOIN drug d ON d.id=pi.drug_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.status='ENABLED' WHERE pi.prescription_id=#{prescriptionId} ORDER BY pi.id ASC

WITH required AS (SELECT drug_id, quantity FROM prescription_item WHERE prescription_id=#{prescriptionId}), qualified AS ( SELECT ph.id FROM pharmacy ph INNER JOIN pharmacy_drug_stock pds ON pds.pharmacy_id=ph.id INNER JOIN required r ON r.drug_id=pds.drug_id WHERE ph.hospital_id=#{hospitalId} AND ph.status='ENABLED' AND ph.deleted_at IS NULL AND pds.available_count >= r.quantity GROUP BY ph.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pds.drug_id)=(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM required) ) SELECT ph.id AS pharmacy_id, ph.name AS pharmacy_name, ph.hospital_id, ph.is_default, pds.drug_id, pds.available_count, pds.unit_price_cent FROM pharmacy ph INNER JOIN qualified q ON q.id=ph.id INNER JOIN pharmacy_drug_stock pds ON pds.pharmacy_id=ph.id INNER JOIN required r ON r.drug_id=pds.drug_id ORDER BY ph.is_default DESC, ph.id ASC, pds.drug_id ASC

SELECT ph.id AS pharmacy_id, ph.name AS pharmacy_name, pds.drug_id, d.name AS drug_name, pi.quantity, pds.available_count, pds.unit_price_cent, pi.dosage, pi.frequency, pi.usage_method, pi.days FROM prescription_item pi INNER JOIN drug d ON d.id=pi.drug_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.status='ENABLED' INNER JOIN pharmacy_drug_stock pds ON pds.drug_id=pi.drug_id INNER JOIN pharmacy ph ON ph.id=pds.pharmacy_id AND ph.status='ENABLED' AND ph.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pi.prescription_id=#{prescriptionId} AND ph.id=#{pharmacyId} ORDER BY pds.drug_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pharmacy_drug_stock SET available_count=available_count-#{quantity}, locked_count=locked_count+#{quantity}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE pharmacy_id=#{pharmacyId} AND drug_id=#{drugId} AND available_count >= #{quantity}

UPDATE pharmacy_drug_stock SET available_count=available_count+#{quantity}, locked_count=locked_count-#{quantity}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE pharmacy_id=#{pharmacyId} AND drug_id=#{drugId} AND locked_count >= #{quantity}
UPDATE pharmacy_drug_stock SET locked_count=locked_count-#{quantity}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE pharmacy_id=#{pharmacyId} AND drug_id=#{drugId} AND locked_count >= #{quantity}
mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1)=1 THEN (ARRAY_AGG(doi.drug_name_snapshot ORDER BY doi.id))[1] ELSE (ARRAY_AGG(doi.drug_name_snapshot ORDER BY doi.id))[1] || '等 ' || COUNT(1)::text || ' 种药品' END FROM drug_order_item doi WHERE doi.drug_order_id=o.id), '药品订单')
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.prescription_id, o.patient_id, o.pharmacy_id, COALESCE(o.pharmacy_name_snapshot, ph.name) AS pharmacy_name, o.status, o.delivery_method, o.delivery_address, o.logistics_company, o.tracking_no, o.logistics_status, o.amount_cent, o.expire_at, po.id AS payment_id, po.status AS payment_status, p.name AS patient_name, p.phone_ciphertext AS patient_phone, po.paid_at + COALESCE(o.estimated_delivery_minutes, 1) * INTERVAL '1 minute' AS expected_delivery_at FROM drug_order o INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id=o.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN pharmacy ph ON ph.id=o.pharmacy_id LEFT JOIN payment_order po ON po.drug_order_id=o.id WHERE o.id=#{drugOrderId} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT drug_id, drug_name_snapshot AS drug_name, quantity, unit_price_cent FROM drug_order_item WHERE drug_order_id=#{drugOrderId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT node, occurred_at FROM drug_order_logistics_trace WHERE drug_order_id=#{drugOrderId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE drug_order SET status='CANCELLED', updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{drugOrderId} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE drug_order SET status='EXPIRED', updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{drugOrderId} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE payment_order SET status='CLOSED', updated_at=#{now} WHERE drug_order_id=#{drugOrderId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE drug_order SET logistics_status='RECEIVED', received_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{drugOrderId} AND status='PAID' AND logistics_status='TO_RECEIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id AS drug_order_id, patient_id, status AS order_status, logistics_status FROM drug_order WHERE id = #{drugOrderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT status FROM drug_order_medication_reminder_activation WHERE drug_order_id = #{drugOrderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug_order_medication_reminder_activation (drug_order_id, user_id, patient_id, status, authorized_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{drugOrderId}, #{userId}, #{patientId}, 'PENDING_RECEIPT', #{now}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (drug_order_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE drug_order_medication_reminder_activation.status = 'PENDING_RECEIPT'
mapper.select: SELECT id AS plan_id, frequency FROM medication_plan WHERE drug_order_id = #{drugOrderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE medication_plan SET reminder_enabled = true, reminder_times = CAST(#{reminderTimesJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), next_remind_at = #{nextRemindAt}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{planId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND reminder_enabled = false AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, appointment_id, drug_order_id FROM payment_order WHERE id=#{paymentId}

SELECT po.id, po.drug_order_id, o.patient_id, po.payer_user_id, o.pharmacy_id, po.status AS payment_status, o.status AS order_status, po.expire_at, u.password_hash FROM payment_order po INNER JOIN drug_order o ON o.id=po.drug_order_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN c_user u ON u.id=po.payer_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE po.id=#{paymentId} AND po.drug_order_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET status='SUCCESS', paid_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{paymentId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE drug_order SET status='PAID', updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{drugOrderId} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug_order_logistics_trace (drug_order_id, node, occurred_at) VALUES (#{drugOrderId}, #{node}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS drug_order_id, o.patient_id, po.payer_user_id FROM drug_order o INNER JOIN payment_order po ON po.drug_order_id = o.id AND po.status = 'SUCCESS' WHERE o.id = #{drugOrderId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY po.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_plan (drug_order_id, patient_id, prescription_item_id, drug_name_snapshot, frequency, usage_method, dosage, duration_days, status, reminder_enabled, created_at, updated_at) SELECT o.id, o.patient_id, pi.id, LEFT(doi.drug_name_snapshot, 128), COALESCE(pi.frequency, '按医嘱'), pi.usage_method, pi.dosage, pi.days, 'ACTIVE', false, #{now}, #{now} FROM drug_order o INNER JOIN drug_order_item doi ON doi.drug_order_id=o.id INNER JOIN prescription_item pi ON pi.prescription_id=o.prescription_id AND pi.drug_id=doi.drug_id WHERE o.id=#{drugOrderId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS drug_order_id, o.patient_id, po.payer_user_id, o.pharmacy_id FROM drug_order o INNER JOIN payment_order po ON po.drug_order_id=o.id WHERE o.id=#{drugOrderId} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
